channel: TCP over a shared Wi-Fi LAN

method.rtt_start: immediately before sending the framed request on an established TCP connection
method.rtt_end: after the complete framed response is received
method.packet_capture: tcpdump on verifier interface; TShark TCP/IP analysis
method.n1024_capture_filter: 30 recorded source streams 48 through 77, renumbered 0 through 29 in the curated capture
method.n16384_capture_filter: recorded source streams 1 through 30; stream 0 in the retained capture is the discarded warmup

interpretation_boundary: RTT includes Wi-Fi transport and resident UAV request processing; it is not isolated radio latency.
TShark retransmission indicators are TCP-layer observations, not IEEE 802.11 MAC retry counts.
Zero application failures does not establish zero physical-layer loss.
Captured EN10MB frame bytes are not Wi-Fi airtime bytes.
These measurements are not physical PUF acquisition timings or fabricated-silicon results.
